avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reducing ribociclib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements with no enzyme induction properties

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increasing ribociclib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use; maintain consistent dietary approach throughout treatment

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase ribociclib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for adverse effects; use at lowest effective dose if continued

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential weak CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 modulation with variable clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; inform healthcare provider of concurrent use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inhibition causing substantial increase in ribociclib systemic exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products throughout entire treatment duration

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase ribociclib absorption and peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take with consistent meal composition; counsel patient on regular meal timing to maintain predictable drug levels

caution_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition with uncertain clinical impact at typical consumption levels
caution_foods.action: Limit intake; monitor for increased adverse effects if consumed regularly

monitoring_notes: Monitor QT interval and cardiac function as ribociclib carries risk of QT prolongation; monitor CBC and liver function tests regularly. Counsel patients to maintain consistent meal patterns and avoid all grapefruit products to prevent unpredictable drug exposure variations.
